definitions.gloss: offering, dedication, devotion (to a shrine or temple)
definitions.explanation: The act of offering something to a deity at a shrine or temple. Can be physical objects (food, sake, art) or performances (dance, music, sumo) dedicated to the gods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奉納|ほうのう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I offered a votive tablet at the shrine.

examples.japanese: {秋祭|あきまつ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奉納|ほうのう}{相撲|ずもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Dedication sumo wrestling is held at the autumn festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奉納|ほうのう}し、⟦{豊作|ほうさく}→豊作：14227_housaku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}した→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: The local people offered harvested rice to the deity, expressing gratitude for the abundant harvest.

notes:
{奉納|ほうのう} is the act of making a religious offering to a Shinto or Buddhist deity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奉納|ほうのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to offer, to dedicate
- {奉納|ほうのう}{舞|まい}: a sacred dance offering
- {奉納|ほうのう}{相撲|ずもう}: dedication sumo
- {奉納|ほうのう}⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧: fireworks dedicated to a deity
- {奉納|ほうのう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: offering, votive object

CULTURAL NOTE:
Offerings can range from simple items like ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (sake), ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (rice), and ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧ (fruit) to elaborate performances like ⟦{神楽|かぐら}→神楽：14078_kagura⟧ (sacred dance), ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧ (sumo), and ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧ (archery). Many ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧ (festivals) center around {奉納|ほうのう} performances.
